warningsAndLimitations.observation: All four first-page and all four returned-to-plaza screenshots visibly retain the dark loading overlay and Korean loading text.
warningsAndLimitations.causeInference: The exact CSS defines a 1s opacity transition, while readyPlaza waits only for .done attachment and screenshot waits for fonts plus two native callbacks. The screenshots are consistent with a fade in progress; they do not establish a permanently stuck loading screen.
warningsAndLimitations.action: Keep the originals. For future completed-scene visual captures, observe computed opacity/transition completion separately before a new screenshot; do not relabel these images as settled quality captures.

warningsAndLimitations.observation: Some animal/clerk/payment emoji locations show hollow missing-glyph shapes. The Sphere desktop mouse glyph is visible, so this is not an absence of every emoji. Korean text remains readable in the inspected captures.
warningsAndLimitations.interpretation: document.fonts.status=loaded does not prove emoji glyph coverage. Environment font coverage is a plausible explanation, not established as the sole cause. No before/after pair here identifies this as a product regression.

warningsAndLimitations.observation: After Escape, hall-desktop, sphere-mobile and sphere-desktop immediately report hidden bkName; hall-mobile reports BODY. After ticket close, hall-desktop and sphere-mobile report hidden boothDone, while the other two report BODY. All immediate reopen snapshots report BODY.
warningsAndLimitations.interpretation: Initial dialog focus, one Tab and inert release are supported. Persistent focus restoration/full tab traversal are not. The immediate snapshots do not establish how long the state lasts.

warningsAndLimitations.observation: Both Sphere runs log one KHR_parallel_shader_compile-not-supported warning. Both Hall runs have no warnings.
warningsAndLimitations.interpretation: This plaza collector records neither dome.mesh.visible nor compile completion. hasDome=true and entrance images are not shader-ready evidence. Separate functional observers must be assessed separately.

warningsAndLimitations.observation: Headless Linux x64 Chromium 153.0.8010.0, Playwright 1.64.1, local fonts, softwareRequested=true and --use-angle=swiftshader; custom flags include --disable-web-security and --no-sandbox.
warningsAndLimitations.interpretation: No actual GL renderer string is captured by this collector. Mobile is 390x844 DPR2 touch emulation, not a physical Android/iOS result. These observations do not establish normal-browser security/network behavior, FPS, heat or battery life.

warningsAndLimitations.observation: The hashed collector uses Playwright keyboard/click/tap/fill and CDP touch input and reads resulting state. No placement fixture was used. Gate targeting reads actual mesh triangles/raycast/DOM hit testing before a real pointer event.
warningsAndLimitations.interpretation: The stored result is state evidence plus a verifiable input code path, not a raw trusted-event trace or complete movement trajectory. Mobile Escape uses keyboard emulation and does not validate a phone soft keyboard.

warningsAndLimitations.observation: The concert images show pre-start entry screens at 0:00. AudioContext state is running; no performance start or auditory output was tested in this plaza suite.
warningsAndLimitations.interpretation: Do not report music quality/synchronization, frame cadence/FPS, load time or long-term stability from these files. Draw counts in snapshots are instantaneous diagnostics, not a controlled performance comparison.

visualReview.method: Read all twenty original PNG files with tools.view_image without editing/cropping or launching a browser. The two final ticket-check images were read from byte-identical transferred files.
visualReview.supported: Ticket text, venue identity and purchase/entry controls are visible in the inspected captures. Ticket number/name match the corresponding raw JSON. Concert entrance frames are before music start.
visualReview.notEstablished: No baseline visual pair, settled first/return plaza screen, complete emoji fidelity, full venue visual quality, performance or dome transition validation.

provenance.planHashStatus: Only matching plan SHA labels in all four completed metadata files were checked; the plan file itself was not read in this review.

reproducibleReviewProcedure: Require completed wrapper PASS, exitCode=0, finishedAt for jobs 0..3.
Hash stdout against each wrapper; cross-check raw/summary/collector/revision and six core regression states.
Independently compare input-induced positions, inert/focus, whole ticket objects, return identity and no-ticket redirect.
Hash git show <revision>:public/<file> for all 19 served entries; compare before/after/across cases.
Inspect twenty original PNGs; separate screenshot timing/font/focus caveats from core flow assertions.
Byte-compare all 36 transferred evidence files to their originals, then rehash before writing only review files.
